text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: KV_CACHE_PAGED_GROWTH detected in us-west-2. Throttles rising, continuous-batching rate doubled in last 5m. Auto-escalation to #incidents triggered.

sara (eng-runtime): seeing rapid metadata growth on blockmgr shards 12-15, eviction not keeping up. dashboard: https://redwood.internal/d/kv/blocked

mike (eng-oncall): oncall here. customers reporting 5-15s tail latency spikes. any immediate mitigations?

anya (eng-sre): recommending immediate downgrade of continuous_batching.max_tokens from 2048 -> 512 and force-disable prefix KV prefetch on canary. will open rollback patch.

jon (eng-runtime): also saw block_size histogram shift — blockmgr creating many tiny blocks due to new packing change from last week's deploy. suspect metadata leak causing GC pressure.

sara (eng-runtime): repro log excerpt: ```
2026-03-15T20:07:12Z ERROR blockmgr: metadata_entries=1.2M total_blocks=980k evict_queue=0
2026-03-15T20:07:12Z WARN kvcache: continuous_batching.batch_size=64 inflight=320
```

mike (eng-oncall): action plan I propose: 1) toggle continuous batching -> off (canary), 2) apply hotfix lowering batch tokens globally for 1h, 3) adjust eviction target to prefer age over size, 4) notify impacted customers. ok? @sara @anya

anya (eng-sre): ACK. I'll run the eviction-adjustment playbook: `playbook/run_eviction_tune --policy age_bias=0.7 --drain-rate=200` on canary first.

jon (eng-runtime): prepping a hotpatch that reverts packing change and bumps block_size_max to 64MB for the affected shards. pushing canary patch now.

incident-bot: :information_source: CHANGE: continuous_batching toggled OFF on canary by mike at 2026-03-15T20:12:05Z.

sara (eng-runtime): canary metrics look healthier — KV metadata growth rate dropped ~65% in the last 2m, eviction events increased as expected. latency tail improving.

katie (support): customer-ops, pinged top 3 customers with status update and mitigation ETA ~30m. customers asking about data loss — confirmed no request payloads lost, only elevated latency. I sent note: "we're applying mitigations, no data loss, will follow up with RCA."

mike (eng-oncall): rolling the hotfix to 20% of prod now (batches + packing revert). monitoring for regressions. @anya please keep the eviction playbook running and keep me posted on drain progress.

anya (eng-sre): eviction playbook running. current drain rate 180/s, estimated stabilization ~22m. logs: ```evict: shard=13 removed=72k meta_entries=+48k->-24k```

jon (eng-runtime): hotpatch deployed to 20% and telemetry shows blockmgr allocs stabilizing. preparing config to increase blockmgr.metadata_cap to 1.5M temporarily to avoid thrash.

mike (eng-oncall): customer-ops, support: new status sent. asking for any increased error rates from app teams. so far only increased latency, no 5xx spike.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: MITIGATION: Hotfix rolled to 20%, continuous_batching toggled off on canary and 80% of canary shards showing expected metrics.

sara (eng-runtime): next steps: 1) hold hotpatch at 20% for 15m, 2) if stable, promote to 100% with staged ramp, 3) follow-up postmortem and revert packing change in mainline with tests. I'll own RCA and include perf-regression tests for batching/packing interactions.

mike (eng-oncall): handing off to eng-runtime for follow-through. I'll stay available for escalation. tagging incident as "active-mitigation" and creating ticket INC-241789 in tracker.

customer-ops: noted. will coordinate direct customer follow-ups and schedule post-incident review with affected accounts.

anya (eng-sre): final check: eviction queue drained to healthy levels, metadata delta trending flat. leaving temporary block_size_max change in place for 2h.

jon (eng-runtime): thanks team. I'll add a canary alert to detect packing->batching interactions so we catch this earlier.

mike (eng-oncall): incident update complete. last_message_ts=2417890401. If anything flares, reopen thread. :sos:
